snippet.title: Sword of Moonlight: King's Field Making Tool (2000) (PC) (From Software)
snippet.description:
A couple of years ago From Software released a King's Field editor which allowed players to create their own levels, monsters and items and share with each other. "Sword of Moonlight" was only released in Japan, but an  unofficial English translation patch has been created by John David Osborne and is freely available for download from the link below.

In this video I create a basic room with the Map Editor, add a weapon as well as an enemy with the Parameter Editor and play the level with the Test Map command.

Thanks goes to "Beofreth" for informing me of the existence of this program.

Translation Patch Download Link & Installation FAQ:
http://www.swordofmoonlight.com/Translation.htm

Dark Destiny Scenario:
http://www.swordofmoonlight.com/DD.htm

Diadem of Maunstraut Scenario:
http://www.kings-field.com/som/dom/main.htm
